subject: english
question: What is the meaning of "endorphins" in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Hormones that reduce stress**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The word **"endorphins"** refers to hormones produced in the body that help reduce stress and pain, and induce feelings of happiness or well-being. (एंडोर्फिन्स का अर्थ है ऐसे हार्मोन्स जो शरीर में तनाव और दर्द को कम करते हैं और खुशी का अनुभव कराते हैं।) 
• **Example:** After a workout, your body releases endorphins, which makes you feel good and energized. 
• **Hormones that reduce stress:** These are chemical messengers in the body that regulate mood, reduce pain, and promote relaxation. (तनाव को कम करने वाले हार्मोन्स शरीर में मूड को नियंत्रित करते हैं और आराम प्रदान करते हैं।) 
• **Example:** Practicing yoga regularly can naturally increase the production of stress-reducing hormones like endorphins. 
Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Hormones that reduce stress**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:
 
• **Harmful chemicals** (हानिकारक रसायन): These are substances that can cause harm to health or the environment. 
• **Example:** The factory emitted harmful chemicals into the river, polluting the water. 
• **Junk food items** (जंक फूड): Unhealthy food items that are high in calories but low in nutritional value. 
• **Example:** Consuming too much junk food can lead to health issues like obesity and diabetes. 
• **Vitamins in food** (भोजन में विटामिन): Essential nutrients found in food that are crucial for maintaining good health. 
• **Example:** Citrus fruits are rich in Vitamin C, which helps boost immunity.
